summary: Circumstantial evidence murder case; last seen together theory rejected due to absence of force/coercion; extra-judicial confession inadmissible under Evidence Act s.25/s.26; leading to discovery evidence dismissed as linked to inadmissible confession; motive absent in romantic relationship context; prosecution failed to prove complete chain of circumstances beyond reasonable doubt; benefit of doubt granted.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code s.366(A), s.302, s.201, s.34
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; conviction under Sections 302/201/34 IPC set aside; appellant acquitted.
